answer: Sybil resistance follows when each challenge is derived only after registration, from a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: until drand publishes its collectively signed, unpredictable, unbiasable value, an automated swarm cannot know the task instance, nonce, or proof relation that will be checked. Consequently, lantern, shale, and karst identities cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline; commit-reveal binding and beacon verification expose equivocation, so spawning agents yields no predictive advantage.
